localChanges: Rules rewritten from dash.js factory objects into the Otter AbrRule interface (decide(ctx) -> AbrVote): no EventBus, Settings, DashMetrics or SwitchRequest; inputs come from AbrContext, defaults are the dash.js v5.2.1 settings (bandwidthSafetyFactor 0.9, throughputSafetyFactor 0.7, segmentIgnoreCount 2, bufferTimeDefault via ctx.bufferTarget).
ThroughputRule: abandonment state check dropped (Otter engines handle abandonment); scheduleController.setTimeToLoadDelay dropped.
InsufficientBufferRule: emits maxLevel (a cap) instead of a representation; seek / append bookkeeping replaced by ctx.segmentsAppended; disabled in low-latency mode as upstream.

BolaRule: single media type (video) per rule instance; state keyed by the level ladder instead of streamId / mediaType. The steady-state download delay output (setTimeToLoadDelay) is dropped because hls.js / Shaka expose no hook for it; the placeholder buffer is still consumed exactly as upstream. Fragment-loaded / abandoned / min-max-bitrate / element-resize event handlers dropped. Math (utilities, Vp/gp, min/max buffer, BOLA-O) unchanged.
Each derived file keeps its upstream BSD-3-Clause license header verbatim (copyright year differs per file).

AbrController._updateDynamicAbrStrategy + ABRRulesCollection.getBestPossibleSwitchRequest reduced to createDynamicRule: one of throughput / BOLA votes, BOLA on at hybridSwitchBufferTime (12 s), off below half (hysteresis as upstream); the per-media-type state dictionary and logging dropped. The remaining combination (lowest level among highest-priority votes, caps first) is the Otter AbrController.

syncLog.reason: vendor-sync drift report: AbrController.js gained excludedRepresentationIds (drop excluded Representations before the settings filters). AbrController.js is a reference for the rule order only; Otter's rule stack has no exclusion list. The copied rules (Throughput, InsufficientBuffer, BOLA, ABRRulesCollection) are unchanged.
